surah.personality_title: Az-Zalzalah — The Apocalyptic Quake & The Microscopic Scales of Justice
surah.personality_summary: Seismic, judicial, revelatory, meticulous. Portrays the earth convulsing in its final earthquake, casting forth its hidden burials and speaking its recorded testimonies. Concludes with the ultimate standard of divine justice: whoever performs an atom's weight of good or evil shall see it.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Az-Zalzala (The Earthquake) is the 99th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 8 ayat. Classified as Madani.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم اذا زلزلت الارض زلزالها
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the earth is shaken violently in its [last] quaking

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the earth discharges its burdens
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the earth throws out its burdens

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when man cries, ‘What is happening to it?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: That Day, it will report its news
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on that Day, it will tell all

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Because your Lord has commanded it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: because your Lord will inspire it [to do so]

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتࣰ ا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يومئذ يصدر الناس اشتاتا ليروا اعمالهم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On that Day, people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرࣰ ا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فمن يعمل مثقال ذرة خيرا يره
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: whoever has done an atom’s-weight of good will see it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةࣲ شَرࣰّ ا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ومن يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but whoever has done an atom’s-weight of evil will see that
